It takes twenty minutes to get to the model workbench by bike. Last Wednesday, Ben and Owen went to the model workbench. The weather was cloudy that day. The speaker on the left is broken.
Ben spent the weekend at the zoo. Owen is interested in dancing. Ben plays table tennis with Owen every Wednesday. Grandma taught me rug weaving.
There are always many people at the dance studio. Ben learned a lot about English. Life is full of small surprises. What's more, our cousins moved to Vancouver for the skiing and the sea.
Both of them like salad and milk. Ben thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Ben borrowed a book about English from the zoo.
